title: AY downstream smoke evidence
description: JSON summary emitted by ay consumer-smoke run --json PATH. The schema documents the artifact shape; release acceptance still depends on the evidence-packet checks in the release tooling.

selected_consumers.description: Names passed with --only. Empty or absent means the full smoke inventory was selected.

unprocessed_consumers.description: Selected smoke consumers that were not reached. Non-empty artifacts are partial blocker evidence, usually from --fail-fast, and are not launch candidates.

evidence.description: Machine-readable classification of the smoke artifact. This lets consumers distinguish full clean downstream evidence from filtered or local smoke runs without re-deriving policy from every row.
evidence.$comment: model_checker_consumer_first_failure_mode is required (the legacy zani_first_failure_mode spelling is no longer accepted). verification_consumer_deductive_checks_clean_origin_main (ex-quantifier_consumer_certificate_consumer_clean_origin_main) is required via the anyOf below: at least one spelling (canonical or legacy alias) must be present, so both pre-rename and post-rename smoke artifacts validate.

scope.description: `full_inventory` means no --only filter was used; `filtered` means the artifact is partial lane evidence.

checkout_mode.description: `clean_temp_worktree` means every selected consumer ran in a clean temporary worktree. `mixed` means some but not all selected consumers used temp worktrees. `local` means no selected consumer used a temp worktree.

launch_candidate.description: True only for full-mode, full-inventory, passing, non-skipped evidence where all consumers have commits, all selected checkouts are clean, model-checker-consumer did not run in first-failure-only mode, and verification-consumer/deductive-checks (ex-quantifier_consumer/certificate_consumer) ran from clean origin/main temp worktrees.

inventory_complete.description: True only when every selected smoke consumer was processed and represented in consumers.

partial.description: True for intentionally incomplete artifacts, such as --fail-fast evidence after a first consumer failure. Partial artifacts are blocker evidence, not launch evidence.

summary_counts_match.description: True only when summary.passed/failed/skipped exactly match the statuses recorded in the consumer rows.

fail_fast.description: True when ay consumer-smoke run ran with --fail-fast.

stopped_after_first_failure.description: True when --fail-fast observed a consumer FAIL and stopped before the selected inventory was exhausted.

all_executed_logs_verified.description: True only when at least one consumer command ran and every executed consumer row has an existing log_path whose SHA-256 matches log_sha256 and whose first two lines match the row's consumer name and command.

ay_head_stable.description: True only when the ay checkout HEAD stayed at the same full commit for the whole smoke run and across every executed consumer command.

ay_worktree_clean.description: True only when the ay checkout worktree status stayed clean for the whole smoke run and across every executed consumer command.

model_checker_consumer_first_failure_mod.description: True when MODEL_CHECKER_CONSUMER_SMOKE_FIRST_FAILURE was set, meaning the model-checker-consumer consumer command ran a bounded first-failure repro instead of the full model-checker-consumer smoke surface.

verification_consumer_deductive_checks_c.description: Canonical (ex-quantifier_consumer_certificate_consumer_clean_origin_main). True when the verification-consumer and deductive-checks consumers both ran from clean origin/main temp worktrees.

quantifier_consumer_certificate_consumer.description: Back-compat alias for verification_consumer_deductive_checks_clean_origin_main. Accepted on pre-rename smoke artifacts; new artifacts should emit verification_consumer_deductive_checks_clean_origin_main.

inventory.description: Inventory file used to decide which downstream consumers must appear in the evidence.

smoke_consumer_count.description: Number of inventory rows with a smoke_script when the artifact was generated.

smoke_consumers.description: Inventory consumers with a smoke_script when the artifact was generated, in inventory order.

tools.description: First-line tool versions captured when the smoke artifact was generated.

git_status_short.description: Raw `git status --short` output for the ay checkout when the smoke run started. Empty means clean.

git_status_short_end.description: Raw `git status --short` output for the ay checkout before JSON was written. Empty means clean.

consumers.$comment: Inventory smoke consumers at schema update (canonical names): "model-checker-consumer", "verification-consumer", "deductive-checks", "ty", "clean" (legacy aliases: quantifier_consumer, certificate_consumer, tla2, proof_replay — still accepted; the former zani alias is no longer accepted). Broad broad public-launch evidence must include every smoke consumer; filtered --only artifacts include only selected consumers.
consumers.description: Consumers come from the development design notes rows with a smoke_script. Full inventory runs include every smoke consumer; filtered --only runs include only selected consumers. Missing checkouts are represented as SKIP rows when selected.

command.description: Exact orchestrator command used for this consumer. Empty only when the consumer command did not run, such as a missing checkout SKIP.

log_path.description: Path to the per-consumer command log. Empty only when the consumer command did not run.

log_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of log_path. Empty only when the consumer command did not run.

ay_commit_full_before.description: Full ay commit immediately before this consumer command. Empty only when the consumer command did not run.

ay_commit_full_after.description: Full ay commit immediately after this consumer command. Empty only when the consumer command did not run.

ay_worktree_status_before.description: ay checkout cleanliness immediately before this consumer command. Empty only when the consumer command did not run.

ay_worktree_status_after.description: ay checkout cleanliness immediately after this consumer command. Empty only when the consumer command did not run.

ay_git_status_short_before.description: Raw `git status --short` output for the ay checkout immediately before this consumer command. Empty means clean or command not run; use ay_worktree_status_before to distinguish.

ay_git_status_short_after.description: Raw `git status --short` output for the ay checkout immediately after this consumer command. Empty means clean or command not run; use ay_worktree_status_after to distinguish.

releaseAcceptanceNotes.$comment: Broad broad public-launch downstream evidence must have evidence.launch_candidate=true. Equivalently: mode=full, evidence.scope=full_inventory, selected_consumers=[], unprocessed_consumers=[], evidence.inventory_complete=true, evidence.partial=false, overall.status=PASS, overall.exit_code=0, summary.failed=0, summary.skipped=0, evidence.summary_counts_match=true, evidence.all_executed_logs_verified=true, evidence.ay_head_stable=true, evidence.ay_worktree_clean=true, evidence.model_checker_consumer_first_failure_mode=false, every inventory smoke consumer at status=PASS with a non-empty commit, clean git_status, non-empty command, existing log_path with matching log_sha256 and matching log header, and verification-consumer/deductive-checks (ex-quantifier_consumer/certificate_consumer) from temp_worktree=true at worktree_ref=origin/main when those checkouts exist.
